title: Add two counts
prompt: Source is supplied. Source.CountAsync(board) returns a task with the number of open tasks on a board. TotalAsync(string first, string second) should read both boards, the first one first, and return the two counts added together. The starter reads only the first board.
hints: How many reads does the method need, and how many does the starter make?
Each read needs its own await before you can use its number.
Await Source.CountAsync(second) into another int and return the sum of the two.
checkLabels: desk has 3 and lab has 5, so the total must be 8.
A board with 0 tasks must add nothing.
The same board twice must count twice.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses the task as if it were its result.
Reads the first board twice and never the second.

feedback: Check that each board is read once, that each read is awaited, and that both numbers reach the return.
